## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the user-visible problem and what changes. Include a small before/after
example for public API changes.

## Validation

List checks actually run and any relevant gaps. Include regression coverage for cancellation, cleanup, replay, or platform behavior when affected.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Public API documentation, examples, and changelog reflect the final behavior.
- [ ] No new third-party runtime dependency or unsupported platform claim.
- [ ] One class/enum/extension/typedef per file; exports updated where needed.
- [ ] Formatting, analysis, and relevant tests pass, or limitations are explained.
- [ ] Credentials and sensitive data are absent from fixtures and logs.
